after.problem: Which expression is equivalent to $(P∧M)∨Q?$
after.worked_solution:
By the commutative law, $P∧M≡M∧P.$

Therefore, $(P∧M)∨Q≡(M∧P)∨Q.$

Finally, by the commutative law, we have

$$
(M∧P)∨Q≡Q∨(M∧P).
$$
